children: Hong Kong energy and tech group's interim revenue rose 56% yr/yr on segment expansion
Net profit for the period fell, mainly due to higher finance costs
Company plans to expand AI chip business and deepen integration with clean energy supply
NEW ENERGY & EPC GROWTH - Co said revenue growth in new energy and EPC segment was due to increased sales volume of photovoltaic components and high-efficiency N-type batteries
HEALTH & WELLNESS SALES - Co said revenue increase in health and wellness segment was mainly due to strong growth in sales volume of green food products
LOWER GROSS MARGIN - Co said gross profit margin declined due to relatively lower margin in new energy and EPC business
HIGHER FINANCE COSTS - Co said net profit fell mainly due to an increase in finance expenses during the period
